description: Defines various event entry structures and dispatch mechanisms for input events in Android's input dispatcher, including key, motion, sensor, focus, drag, and configuration change events.

classes.name: EventEntry
classes.description: Base class for all input event types, providing common properties and methods.

classes.name: PointerCaptureChangedEntry
classes.description: Represents a pointer capture change event.

classes.name: KeyEntry
classes.description: Represents a key input event, including key code, action, and state.

classes.name: MotionEntry
classes.description: Represents a motion (touch, stylus, etc.) input event.

classes.name: TouchModeEntry
classes.description: Represents a change in touch mode.

classes.name: DispatchEntry
classes.description: Tracks the dispatching status of an input event to a target.

methods.name: isInjected
methods.description: Checks if the event was injected from an external source.

methods.name: isSynthesized
methods.description: Checks if the event is synthesized or injected.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a string description of the event.

methods.name: releaseInjectionState
methods.description: Releases resources associated with injection state.

methods.name: ConfigurationChangedEntry
methods.description: Constructor for configuration change event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for configuration change event.

methods.name: DeviceResetEntry
methods.description: Constructor for device reset event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for device reset event.

methods.name: FocusEntry
methods.description: Constructor for focus change event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for focus change event.

methods.name: PointerCaptureChangedEntry
methods.description: Constructor for pointer capture change event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for pointer capture change event.

methods.name: DragEntry
methods.description: Constructor for drag event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for drag event.

methods.name: KeyEntry
methods.description: Constructor for key event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for key event.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Recycles resources used by the key event.

methods.name: MotionEntry
methods.description: Constructor for motion event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for motion event.

methods.name: SensorEntry
methods.description: Constructor for sensor event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for sensor event.

methods.name: TouchModeEntry
methods.description: Constructor for touch mode event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description for touch mode event.

methods.name: DispatchEntry
methods.description: Constructor for dispatch tracking.

methods.name: hasForegroundTarget
methods.description: Checks if the dispatch targets the foreground.

methods.name: isSplit
methods.description: Checks if the dispatch is split.
